structure.text: The sitemaps list 9322 URLs across locale prefixes such as /en-us (690 URLs), /en-uk, /en-int and /de-de.
The en-us model URL template is /en-us/hearing-devices/hearing-aids/{slug}, with 27 URLs, for example audeo-eon, audeo-eon-sphere and audeo-fit.
A product-comparison page sits under the same path and is not a model page.
Other locales use translated paths, such as /de-de/hoerloesungen/hoersysteme/{slug} and /fr-fr/systemes-auditifs/aides-auditives/{slug}.
The en-us knowledge base has 285 articles at /en-us/support/knowledge-base/articles/{slug}.
robots.txt lists a sitemap per locale, including https://www.phonak.com/en-us/sitemap.xml.

what.text: Phonak is a hearing aid brand site; the footer reads 'Phonak – A Sonova brand'.
The site sells hearing aids, accessories, Roger microphones, earplugs and apps, and has a professional section.

where.text: The catalog is https://www.phonak.com/en-us/hearing-devices/hearing-aids, with a side-by-side comparison page.
Datasheets are at /en-us/support/datasheets, organised by Infinio, Lumity, Paradise, Marvel, Belong and Lyric platform tabs.
User guides are split by page: /support/user-guides/infinio, /eon, /accessories, /apps and /chargers.
The myPhonak app page is /en-us/hearing-devices/apps/myphonak, with a user guide archive back to version 4.0.4.
The phone compatibility checker is at /en-us/support/phone-compatibility.

summary.text: Phonak's live, multi-locale brand site (Sonova brand) with model pages under /hearing-devices/hearing-aids and datasheets and user guides under /support; the en-us catalog and support pages are readable as plain page text.
